boundary: General algorithms only. Review pairs are used for model-level development calibration and evaluation, never as exceptions or scope logic. Observed transfer data is a regression set, not an untouched benchmark. Supplied scope descriptions, rival relations, rejected label names and scope probes are not consulted by clustering or labeling.
labeling: Shared c-TF-IDF-like term ranking: aggregate per-note unigram/bigram counts, normalize class term frequencies, log(1 + average class token count / total class term count). Standard English stopwords and min document frequency 2, no custom excluded words. Overlapping memberships duplicate counts across classes. Top five terms and three centroid-nearest members are review artifacts, not validated final topic names.
